newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end slightly firmer in light activity.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end slightly firmer in light activity.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended the day slightly firmer on local buying, as prices consolidated after sharp losses Tuesday, floor sources said.
Speculative buying supported the November contract around 110.00. Resistance was pegged at 115.00.
The spot-November contract finished at 110.65, up 0.60, having ranged from 111.45 to 110.05. The back months settled 0.25 higher to 0.75 lower.
The last trading day for November FCOJ options is Friday.
Players continue to await the U.S. Department of Agriculture's estimate for the 1996/97 Florida crop, to be released October 11.
